items.name: Golden Forest Fox Den
items.guide: Follow the fox from the golden tree shrine through the bamboo path to honor the Inari shrine.

items.name: Hiyoshi Springs Fox Den
items.guide: Follow the fox down the rock stepped incline to uncover the hidden shrine.

items.name: Kashine Fox Den
items.guide: Follow the spirit fox across the wooden log crossing to honor the altar.

items.name: Ariake Fox Den
items.guide: Navigate the tranquil flower marsh following the fox to the shrine.

items.name: Hiyoshi Bamboo Strike
items.guide: Complete 3-hit, 5-hit, and 7-hit button combos to increase maximum resolve.

items.name: Komatsu Bamboo Strike
items.guide: Strike true with the katana sequence behind the blacksmith furnaces.

items.name: Ariake Bamboo Strike
items.guide: Perform rapid button sequences overlooking the river valley.

items.name: Hiyoshi Hot Spring
items.guide: Rest and reflect on your path to increase Jin Sakai's maximum health.

items.name: Quiet Basin Hot Spring
items.guide: Submerge into the spring water surrounded by pampas grass.

items.name: Golden Leaf Hot Spring
items.guide: Meditate beneath yellow ginkgo canopies for permanent health boost.

items.name: Hiyoshi Haiku
items.guide: Reflect on serenity and loss to compose a three-line verse and unlock the Headband of Peace.

items.name: Ariake Haiku
items.guide: Compose poetry viewing blooming lanterns and acquire the Headband of Hope.

shrine_challenges.name: Arrow Peak Shinto Shrine
shrine_challenges.guide: Traverse broken rope bridges, jump across jagged rock spires, and honor the torii gate for the Charm of Inari.

shrine_challenges.name: Winding Mountain Shrine
shrine_challenges.guide: Grapple tree cranes and scale sheer cliffs to claim the Charm of Izanami.

objectives: Follow Yuna to Kechi Fishing Village
walkthrough_missions.guide: Embrace stealth assassination for the first time with Yuna, learning focused hearing and the way of the Ghost.

objectives: Track Ishikawa's footprints to the mountain
walkthrough_missions.guide: Master archery mechanics under the legendary Sensei and uncover Tomoe's rebellion.

objectives: Survive the ambush by masked rogues
Track the conspirators to Golden Temple
walkthrough_missions.guide: Help Lady Masako seek vengeance against the conspirators who slaughtered Clan Adachi.

objectives: Eliminate Mongol guards in the outer courtyard
Duel the Straw Hat Ronin traitor
walkthrough_missions.guide: Infiltrate Castle Kaneda via grappling hook, breach the keep, defeat Ryuzo in the duel, and liberate Lord Shimura.

blades_and_bows.name: Sakai Katana
blades_and_bows.description: Ancestral blade forged from folded tamahagane steel.

blades_and_bows.name: Sakai Tanto
blades_and_bows.description: Compact companion blade honed for lightning-fast assassinations.

blades_and_bows.name: Half Bow
blades_and_bows.description: Quick-drawing bow favored by hunters and ronin for medium-range combat.

blades_and_bows.name: Longbow
blades_and_bows.description: Powerful heavy bow capable of piercing Mongol steel armor and firing explosive arrows.

trophies_and_achievements.name: Gathering Storm
trophies_and_achievements.description: Recover the katana of clan Sakai.

trophies_and_achievements.name: Point of No Return
trophies_and_achievements.description: Break the code to save a friend.

trophies_and_achievements.name: Dying Embers
trophies_and_achievements.description: Eradicate the traitors in the name of a fallen friend.

trophies_and_achievements.name: Mono No Aware
trophies_and_achievements.description: Leave the past behind and accept the burden of your new mantle.
